description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an interface for a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with locking mechanisms, data reading/writing, and buffer management functionalities. The class is designed for inter-process data sharing with thread safety and synchronization features.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class providing a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer management capabilities, designed for inter-process communication.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A helper class for peeking and managing read positions within the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructs a CyclicBuffer instance either from a filename and mode or from a DataElementFile object.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Acquires exclusive access to the buffer, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, destructive read that advances the tail.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for upcoming writes.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Notification callback when data becomes available.
